title: Explore, Execute, Evolve: A Skill Acquisition and Reuse Loop for Embodied Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.37810v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action and world-action models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in robotics, yet generalization to unseen tasks remains challenging. More recently, general-purpose multimodal agents have shown great potential for zero-shot robotic task solving. However, they often incur high execution costs by reasoning and exploring the physical world from scratch. To reduce these costs, we introduce RoboSkill, a framework that connects skill acquisition and reuse through an Explore, Execute, Evolve loop. Within this loop, the agent explores to gather task-relevant information, executes tasks while adapting to feedback, and evolves its skill library based on execution records. It then reuses these skills to guide exploration and execution in the next cycle, closing the loop. translated_title: 探索、执行、演化：面向具身智能体的技能获取与复用循环
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作模型和世界-动作模型在机器人领域展现了令人印象深刻的能力，但对未见任务的泛化仍然具有挑战性。近期，通用多模态智能体在零样本机器人任务求解方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，这些智能体通过从头推理和探索物理世界来完成任务，往往导致高昂的执行成本。为了降低这些成本，我们提出了RoboSkill，一个通过“探索、执行、演化”循环将技能获取与复用连接起来的框架。在该循环中，智能体进行探索以收集与任务相关的信息，在执行任务的同时适应反馈，并基于执行记录演化其技能库。随后，智能体复用这些技能来指导下一个循环中的探索与执行，从而闭合整个循环。为了提高循环效率，我们通过触觉反馈补充视觉信息，以减少物理交互过程中的不确定性。我们进一步增强了文本引导（原文在此截断）。
tldr: RoboSkill框架通过“探索-执行-演化”循环实现具身智能体的技能获取与复用，并结合触觉反馈降低物理交互的不确定性，从而显著降低多模态智能体解决机器人任务的高昂执行成本。
en_tdlr: RoboSkill connects skill acquisition and reuse through an Explore-Execute-Evolve loop with tactile feedback, reducing the high execution costs incurred by general-purpose multimodal agents in zero-shot robotic task solving.
